name: Franklin College
academic_ranking: Private liberal arts college in Franklin, IN. Offers Bachelor of Arts degrees across 49 majors from 25 academic disciplines, 43 minors, 11 pre-professional programs, and 5 cooperative programs, plus master's programs in Athletic Training and Physician Assistant Studies. Enrollment ~966 (fall 2023) with roughly 81 full-time and 35 part-time faculty.
financial_aid: Full-time undergraduate tuition $40,230 for the 2026-27 academic year. Franklin College processed $35.5 million in financial aid in 2023-24. Per College Navigator, 100% of full-time beginning undergraduates received grant or scholarship aid.
facilities_notes: NCAA Division III program; as a D3 institution Franklin College does not offer athletic scholarships. Softball facility details not detailed on program pages checked 2026-07.
program_reputation: NCAA Division III softball program (Grizzlies) competing in the Heartland Collegiate Athletic Conference, of which Franklin College is a charter and current member.
notes: Data gathered from franklingrizzlies.com softball staff and roster pages, franklincollege.edu, and NCES College Navigator on 2026-07. NCAA D3 - no athletic scholarships offered; scholarship_count set to null. Team-level social handle @FCGrizSoftball; no individual coach Twitter/X handles listed.
